text.p: These are the main news headlines reported by Latvian State Radio on Friday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A person suspected for embezzling $100 million from a Latvian bank in 1991 has been detained at Moscow airport.
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele participates in a gathering of the heads of EU aspirant states.
- Deputy Prime Minister Anatolijs Gorbunovs addressed the 19th Session of the UN General Assembly.
- UK Deputy Prime Minister John Prescott, meeting Gorbunovs in New York, said Britain is interested in signing an agreement on sea transport with Latvia.
